_README: Migration run for Ultimate Supercar Garage. Generated from orchestration/plan-template.json. project=supercar-garage, namespace=usg, mixNamespace=usgmix, siteKey=supercar-garage, language=fr. Page tree in orchestration/sitemaps/supercar-garage.txt. Run: ORCH_URL=http://localhost:8001 bash orchestration/run.sh orchestration/plans/supercar-garage.plan.json --watch. Prereq: projects/supercar-garage/.env defines JAHIA_USER, JAHIA_HOST, JAHIA_MCP_TOKEN. Keep PROBE: lines verbatim.
goal: Migrate https://www.ultimate-supercar-garage.com/fr-FR to a Jahia JS module (project: supercar-garage, namespace usg, siteKey supercar-garage, language fr). Each step is proven by its PROBE command; a step is done only when the probe exits 0.

epics.title: Foundation: connect + analyze
epics.goal: Confirm Jahia reachable and produce a complete component/content manifest.

stories.title: Analyze the reference site
stories.description: Verify connectivity, then analyze https://www.ultimate-supercar-garage.com/fr-FR into a manifest and content data.

steps.title: Analyze -> manifest (Gate 1: HALT)
acceptance_criteria: Use the namespace provided in inputs (usg / usgmix) for EVERY nodeType in component-manifest.json — do NOT invent a different prefix.

News articles (actualites/*) and press releases (presse/communique-de-presse/*) are jmix:mainResource detail content types: set needsMainResource:true with both a default (card) and fullPage view. They are NOT pure SXA-search listings.

BROWSER-FIRST CAPTURE (anti-hallucination): the site is JS/WAF — the wget cache is only the static shell. Per .agents/skills/capture-reference/SKILL.md, capture via the browser (Chrome MCP) each page's real rendered text, the COMPLETE item list (e.g. ALL news articles, not the 2 the cache has), real image URLs, and facet/taxonomy values + counts, into projects/supercar-garage/.reference/captured/. Build content-data.json from this captured truth — never fabricate summaries/titles/taxonomy/images.
Write ALL 4 SKILL Step 8 outputs: analysis.md, component-manifest.json, content-data.json, asset-inventory.json.

If the source is Sitecore SXA (.component / .component-content / field-* in the cached DOM), components are DECLARED in the markup — do NOT eyeball-discover them. Per .agents/skills/sitecore-sxa/SKILL.md, run the deterministic extractor (python3 orchestration/lib/sxa-extract.py projects/

/.reference/cache > projects/

/.reference/sxa-components.json) and account for EVERY extracted component in component-manifest.json: each Jahia type carries sxaSource:[...]; deliberately-skipped generics go in a top-level sxaIgnored:[...]. No silent drops.
Gate 1: present section map + field splits, return status halt.

epics.goal: Scaffold module (namespace usg) and import assets into static/.

review_criteria: CSS tokenized into :root theme vars (css-tokens gate)

stories.title: Scaffold the module
stories.description: Create module namespace usg; confirm build.

steps.title: Scaffold (Gate 2: HALT)
acceptance_criteria: Gate 2: present structure + namespace, return status halt.

epics.title: Content model: types + navigation + listing
epics.goal: CND types, 3-level navigation, JCRQuery + GridRow in namespace usg.

review_criteria: types in definitions.cnd with en+fr labels + ui.tooltip
nav 3 levels via Navigation Menu component
JCRQuery + GridRow shipped; tags/categories use built-ins

stories.title: Define content types
stories.description: CND + types.ts for every manifest component, i18n labels + ui.tooltip.

steps.title: Define CND types
acceptance_criteria: Use /jahia-cnd-author (loads the CND reference docs) for non-trivial modeling; weakreferences need a TYPE constraint (e.g. `< jmix:image`), not just a picker.
Reuse/views: no two types may share a property shape (consolidate into one type + views): PROBE: bash orchestration/probes/dup-shapes.sh projects/supercar-garage usg
After types approval, write the per-project reuse baseline: PROBE: bash orchestration/probes/inventory.sh projects/supercar-garage usg --write projects/supercar-garage/component-baseline.txt

stories.title: 3-level navigation
stories.description: MainNavigation backed by JCR page tree, 3 levels, matching orchestration/sitemaps/supercar-garage.txt.

steps.title: Implement MainNavigation
acceptance_criteria: Navigation must render 3 levels deep from the JCR page tree (getChildNodes on home for L1, recurse for L2 and L3), matching orchestration/sitemaps/supercar-garage.txt. No hardcoded links. L2/L3 render as dropdown/fly-out.

epics.title: Components + templates + deploy
epics.goal: Implement all components verbatim, build templates, deploy ACTIVE.

review_criteria: every component has a view + label

stories.title: All components
stories.description: Implement every manifest component with verbatim reference class names + i18n.

steps.title: Implement components
acceptance_criteria: Implement components ONE at a time — never batch-stub them all then build at the end. The build-time gate here is components-all.sh: it validates source-pairing + no-stub + en/fr i18n for EVERY component and builds once. NOTE: component-validate.sh additionally DEPLOYS and RENDERS a non-home page, so it only passes AFTER content/pages exist — it is a POST-CONTENT per-component debugging gate (used while iterating on a single deployed component), NOT run at this step.

Per-component completeness gate over EVERY component (loops each, FAILS naming any stubbed / unlabelled / viewless component, builds the module once): PROBE: bash orchestration/probes/components-all.sh projects/supercar-garage usg

steps.title: Layout + templates
acceptance_criteria: 2-3 page templates by ROLE (home/section/detail); restrict each Area with allowedNodeTypes (.agents/skills/08-page-templates): PROBE: bash orchestration/probes/template-govern.sh projects/supercar-garage

steps.title: Deploy (Gate 3: HALT)
acceptance_criteria: Render-gate the deployed shell (header/nav/footer must not be collapsed/broken): PROBE: bash orchestration/probes/render-all.sh projects/supercar-garage supercar-garage fr /home
Gate 3: present deployed shell screenshot, return status halt.

epics.title: Content + review + accessibility
epics.goal: Create + publish all content, review, accessibility audit.

stories.title: Create + publish content
stories.description: Create and publish all pages (orchestration/sitemaps/supercar-garage.txt) to live.

steps.title: Create content (Gate 4: HALT)
acceptance_criteria: Use the Jahia MCP server (JSON-RPC at $JAHIA_HOST/modules/mcp) for ALL node creation, property edits, and publishing. GraphQL is a fallback only when the MCP cannot do it; state any fallback in the summary.

IDEMPOTENT: for each path in orchestration/sitemaps/supercar-garage.txt, check existence with MCP content.get (locale fr); if missing, page.create it; if present, REUSE the node (never recreate/duplicate). Use lowercase node names (Jahia lowercases them). Then fill each empty page's main area with components mirroring the reference URL.

IMAGES = DAM weakreferences, NEVER url strings (AGENTS.md 2a). Import via MCP media.upload.url (consistent UUID), set the WEAKREFERENCE field (image/backgroundImage/logo/photo), clear any *ExternalUrl string. Canonical tools: orchestration/images/set_hero_refs.py and set_image_refs.py supercar-garage supercar-garage usg. Capture source URLs via browser (site blocks the agent).
PROBE: bash orchestration/probes/content.sh projects/supercar-garage supercar-garage fr @orchestration/sitemaps/supercar-garage.txt
PROBE: bash orchestration/probes/no-url-images.sh projects/supercar-garage supercar-garage usg

Render-gate EACH page as you finish it (do not defer to the end). The step is not done until every page renders clean: PROBE: bash orchestration/probes/render-all.sh projects/supercar-garage supercar-garage fr @orchestration/sitemaps/supercar-garage.txt

Publish completeness: every weakref'd asset (image/logo/link/category) must resolve in LIVE and every fr translation must be published (publish WITH languages:[fr]): PROBE: bash orchestration/probes/publish-parity.sh projects/supercar-garage supercar-garage fr

Editability: shared regions (nav/footer/topbar) must render AND be editable in Page Builder, not blank (AbsoluteAreas need child content nodes): PROBE: bash orchestration/probes/edit-frame.sh projects/supercar-garage supercar-garage fr home

Quality: every page passes a11y (axe-core, no critical/serious) + SEO baseline (title, meta, single h1, img alt): PROBE: bash orchestration/probes/site-review.sh projects/supercar-garage supercar-garage fr @orchestration/sitemaps/supercar-garage.txt

Reuse guard: content/page discovery must NOT add types beyond the approved per-project baseline: PROBE: bash orchestration/probes/no-new-types.sh projects/supercar-garage usg projects/supercar-garage/component-baseline.txt
Gate 4: present reference vs Jahia screenshots, return status halt.

stories.title: Review + accessibility
stories.description: Code review + axe-core audit; write reports.

steps.title: Code review (Gate 5: HALT)
acceptance_criteria: Use the jahia-reviewer agent (.claude/agents/jahia-reviewer.md): run ALL gate probes (no-stub, cnd-review, render-all, publish-parity, edit-frame, site-review) and review faithful-DOM/editability/content-fidelity/i18n; write REVIEW.md with a verdict. APPROVE only if every gate is green and no critical/major finding stands.
Reuse/views: no two types may share a property shape (consolidate into one type + views): PROBE: bash orchestration/probes/dup-shapes.sh projects/supercar-garage usg

Reuse guard against the FROZEN baseline (do NOT re-write it here — it was frozen at step_content_types): PROBE: bash orchestration/probes/no-new-types.sh projects/supercar-garage usg projects/supercar-garage/component-baseline.txt
Gate 5: present findings, return status halt.
